messages:
PagerDuty-Bot: URGENT: High-severity alert: potential S3 ACL misconfiguration detected against bucket redwood-usage-logs-prod. Affected objects: anonymized-logs/2026-11-05/*. Auto-investigation kicked off. @Ava you're on initial pager.

Ava (oncall): Confirming receipt. I'm pulling the bucket ACLs now. Any indication of external IP access?

Diego (infra): I can see a recent ACL change at 2026-11-05T03:12Z from a deploy job. `aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket redwood-usage-logs-prod` shows `Grantee: AllUsers (READ)`. Not all objects are public but prefix `anonymized-logs/2026-11-05/` looks readable.

Ava (oncall): Copy. Initiating containment: removing public ACL, enabling bucket policy deny-public. @Priya please triage customer-impact scope.

Priya (security): On it. Quick note: these logs contain request metadata (customer_id hashed, region, model_name, token_count), and a small fraction include full prompt text for debug traces when dev flag was true. Need to confirm how many objects contain prompt text.

Diego (infra): Running `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-usage-logs-prod/anonymized-logs/2026-11-05/ --recursive | wc -l` now.

InfraBot: 234 objects under prefix. Scanning sample of 50 objects for `prompt` fields...

Priya (security): From sample, ~6/50 contain `debug_trace` JSON with prompt contents (cleartext). Extrapolating ~= 28 objects total. We'll need to iterate full scan to confirm.

OpsLead - Jordan: If any prompt contents include user PII or API keys we escalate to Legal and Compliance immediately. @Maya please stand by.

Maya (legal): Standing by. Also need to know affected customer list and whether hashed customer_id is reversible given our salt/pepper. If salted and managed properly, risk lower, but still requires disclosure if prompt text includes any identifiable info.

Ava (oncall): Containment step executed: removed public ACL, applied deny-public bucket policy, triggered S3 object-level lock off for further writes. Deploy job permissions being rolled back. Rolling forward a read-only copy for forensics (no external access).

Diego (infra): Confirmed deny-public policy now in effect at 2026-11-05T03:24Z. Backup snapshot taken to forensics bucket `forensics/redwood-usage-logs-prod/1825601234/`. Access limited to sec+legal+infra.

Priya (security): Triage plan: 1) Full scan for `debug_trace` objects 2) Extract list of potentially affected customer_ids 3) Determine whether any objects were downloaded (S3 access logs review) 4) Draft initial customer-safe notice + status page copy. ETA for scan: 45–60m.

Ava (oncall): Handing off to Diego for deeper infra work. I'm moving to monitoring for anomalies and supporting queries. @Jordan please coordinate comms.

OpsLead - Jordan: Copy. I'll draft the internal incident bulletin and a cautious customer notification for review by Legal. Starting with internal stakeholders: CSMs, Sales AE owners, Trust.

Maya (legal): Please avoid speculative language in external notices. Use factual confirmed scope + next steps. Legal prefers: "We identified a configuration issue that may have allowed public access to a subset of logs; we have secured the data and are investigating scope." We'll review the draft before sending.

Priya (security): Status page snippet (draft):

```
Incident: Potential exposure of usage logs
Status: Investigating (Mitigated)
Impact: A subset of usage logs may have been publicly accessible for a limited time. We have removed public access and are conducting a scope assessment.
ETA next update: 60 minutes
```

OpsLead - Jordan: Draft customer notification (internal draft, do NOT send yet):

```
Hi <Customer Contact>,

We're reaching out to let you know we are investigating a configuration issue that may have impacted access to a subset of usage logs related to your account. We have secured the data and are actively assessing the scope. At this time we do not have evidence of targeted access to your data. We will provide another update within 4 hours with findings and any recommended next steps.

If you have privacy or security questions in the meantime, please contact trust@redwood.com.

Regards,
Redwood Trust
```

Maya (legal): Suggested edits: remove phrase "may have impacted access to a subset of usage logs related to your account" — instead use "a subset of usage logs that may include metadata associated with some customer accounts." Add sentence: "If we determine that any of your data was accessed, we will notify you with specific details and remediation steps." Add Cc: your Customer Success rep.

Priya (security): Checking S3 access logs now for `GetObject` from external IPs in the window 2026-11-05T03:00Z–03:25Z.

InfraBot: Found 12 `GetObject` operations from external IPs flagged as non-internal in same time window. Download sizes vary; investigating which object keys downloaded.

Ava (oncall): Any hits on sensitive keys (e.g., `debug_trace` objects)?

InfraBot: 3 `GetObject` map to keys with `debug_trace` in metadata. Keys: anonymized-logs/2026-11-05/obj-042.json, obj-099.json, obj-201.json.

Priya (security): That confirms potential partial exposure of prompt content. Next steps: full list of distinct customer_ids from those objects, check whether hashed ids reversible. Diego please hand over hash-salt config.

Diego (infra): Hash uses SHA256 with per-tenant salt stored in Vault v2. Salt retrieval is allowed only with MDA role. I'll coordinate access for Sec+Legal for analysis.

Maya (legal): If prompt content includes customer-owned PII, we need to follow our notification obligations. Also consider regulator notification if GDPR data subjects affected — prepare Data Protection Assessment.

Jordan (OpsLead): Preparing internal comms template for CSMs: short bullet points, what to say, escalation contacts. Draft below: 

- We identified a configuration issue that briefly allowed public access to a subset of usage logs.
- We secured the data and are investigating scope.
- We have no evidence of targeted access to customer data beyond routine downloads.
- We will inform customers within 4 hours with confirmed findings.
- CSMs: please escalate any customer concerns to trust@redwood.com.

Priya (security): Full scan finishing. Preliminary count: 28 objects with debug_trace; 3 downloaded externally. Affected hashed_customer_ids mapping to three tenant ids: tenant-alpha, tenant-gamma, tenant-delta (internal canonical names).

Maya (legal): For the three tenants flagged, Legal wants to prepare individualized disclosure. Legal recommends we notify those customers within 2 hours with specifics and offer remediation support. For others, send a general notice if we can't confirm targeted access.

Ava (oncall): Moving to monitoring for suspicious API behavior for those three tenants. Enabling rate-limits and alert rules for anomalous queries.

Jordan (OpsLead): Draft external email to affected customers (for Legal review):

```
Subject: Important: Brief exposure of limited usage logs — immediate update

Hi <Name>,

We’re contacting you because our investigation has identified that a small number of usage log files associated with your account were briefly accessible due to a configuration error. We have already secured the files and taken steps to prevent recurrence.

What happened: a deployment misconfiguration temporarily made a subset of our usage logs publicly readable between 03:12 and 03:24 UTC on 2026-11-05. During that window, 3 files containing debug traces were downloaded.

What we are doing: we have revoked public access, taken a forensics snapshot, and are performing a thorough review. We are also offering support to review the downloaded contents with you and to recommend mitigations.

Next steps: we will share the specific files and content details in a secure channel within 4 hours, and provide recommended remediation (e.g., rotation of keys if any were present). If you prefer, we can schedule a call.

We take data protection seriously and apologize for the incident. If you have immediate questions, reply to this email or contact your Redwood Customer Success rep.

Regards,
Redwood Trust/Legal
```

Maya (legal): Sounds close. Edits: include a sentence about "no evidence of misuse to date" only if confirmed. Also add "We will provide technical details and a secure delivery mechanism for the files." Provide cc to your security contact.

Priya (security): For status page update (finalized for public):

```
Incident: Usage log configuration issue — partial exposure
Status: Mitigated
Impact: A small number of usage log files were briefly publicly readable. We have secured the data and identified three files that were downloaded. We are notifying affected customers and continuing our investigation.
Next update: 4 hours or when we have more details.
```

OpsLead - Jordan: Noting timeline for communications: 1) Internal bulletin to CSMs + Sales in 30m 2) Targeted notices to three affected tenants after Legal sign-off within 2 hours 3) Public status page update in 60m.

Ava (oncall): Handoff: I'm free after 04:30 UTC. Diego, Priya and Jordan will remain on the thread for action items. If anything else pops, page me.

Diego (infra): Rolling patch to deployment job to remove write of ACL changes and add pre-deploy ACL tests. Patch merged; pre-deploy test added to CI: check `aws s3api get-bucket-acl` expected grantees.

Priya (security): Final note to include in all customer notices: contact trust@redwood.com and provide a secure artifact exchange option. Also preserve chain of custody for forensics.

Maya (legal): I will review the draft emails and status copy now. Jordan, please queue the drafts into Legal review doc and mark them high priority.

Jordan (OpsLead): Done. Added communication tasks to incident runbook and pinged CSM leads. Will post internal bulletin once Legal confirms wording.

InfraBot: Full scan completed. Confirmed 28 debug_trace objects; 3 downloaded externally. Forensics snapshot and access logs archived to `forensics/redwood-usage-logs-prod/1825601234/`. Access restricted.

Priya (security): Closing immediate containment. Next actions: forensics analysis, customer notification (Legal to approve), CI pre-deploy check enforcement. Will monitor for follow-ups.

Ava (oncall): Thanks team. Moving to standby.

Jordan (OpsLead): I'll post the internal bulletin in 15 minutes and coordinate the targeted customer emails after legal sign-off.

Maya (legal): Reviewing now. Expect edits in ~20m.

[thread closed at 1825602450]
